setting.enabled.label: Enabled
setting.on_click.label: Mouse clicks
setting.on_click.description: Ripple where you press a mouse button.
setting.on_touch.label: Touch & pen
setting.on_touch.description: Ripple where a finger or tablet pen touches down.
setting.on_focus.label: Window focus
setting.on_focus.description: Ripple across a window when it takes focus from a keybind, a new window or a closed one.
setting.focus_hover.label: Hover focus
setting.focus_hover.description: Also ripple when focus follows the mouse. Busy with follow_mouse = 1.
setting.on_workspace.label: Workspace switch
setting.on_workspace.description: Flood the screen with ink when you change workspace.
setting.color.label: Color
setting.color.description: A theme color (accent, foreground, color4, ...) or #rrggbb. Theme colors follow theme switches.
setting.style.label: Preset
setting.style.description: Classic, Ring and Sparkle draw ink. Negative inverts colors, Water and Water (Short) bend the image, and Prism refracts it. Opacity controls the effect strength. Each preset remembers its opacity, radius and softness; Water, Water (Short) and Prism also remember distortion.
setting.opacity.label: Opacity
setting.opacity.description: Peak opacity of the ink. Material uses about 0.12 to 0.3.
setting.radius.label: Click radius
setting.radius.description: How far a click ripple spreads.
setting.softness.label: Edge softness
setting.sparkle_amount.label: Sparkle amount
setting.sparkle_amount.description: How much shimmering grain the sparkle preset carries. 0 is a plain glow.
setting.distortion.label: Distortion
setting.distortion.description: How hard the wave bends what's under it.
setting.ring_width.label: Ring width
setting.hold.label: Grow while held
setting.hold.description: The ripple keeps growing while you hold the button and fades when you let go. When this is off, each ripple runs for the set duration.
setting.duration.label: Duration
setting.duration.description: Time for one ripple to spread and fade.
setting.focus_origin.label: Focus origin
setting.bounded.label: Clip to window
setting.bounded.description: Keep click, tap and focus ripples inside their window, bar or launcher. Clicks on the desktop stay unclipped.
setting.workspace_radius.label: Workspace radius
setting.workspace_radius.description: “screen” covers the entire monitor. A number sets a fixed radius in pixels.
setting.max_ripples.label: Max ripples
setting.max_ripples.description: When this limit is reached, the oldest ripples disappear.
setting.skip_fullscreen.label: Skip fullscreen
setting.skip_fullscreen.description: No ripples on a monitor showing a fullscreen game, video or other window.
setting.pause_when_sharing.label: Pause while sharing
setting.pause_when_sharing.description: No ripples while the screen is being shared or recorded.
setting.exclude.label: Excluded apps
setting.exclude.description: Window classes to exclude, separated by commas. Supports * and ?, for example steam_app_*, mpv.
